25th percentile (Q1)

Source: R/q1q3.r
ks_q1.Rd

Computes the 25th percentile using quantile.

The quantile algorithm type can be set globally via options(kstools.quantile.type = <1..9>) (e.g. in .Rprofile). Type 2 matches SAS default; type 7 is the R default. When the option is not set the package default of 2 is used.

Usage

ks_q1(x, na.rm = TRUE, type = getOption("kstools.quantile.type", default = 2L))

Arguments

x

Numeric vector.

na.rm

Logical; remove NAs before computing. Default TRUE.

type

Integer (1–9); quantile algorithm passed to quantile. Defaults to getOption("kstools.quantile.type", 2L).

See also

ks_q3, quantile

Examples

## Use R default algorithm for this call
ks_q1(rnorm(100), type = 7)
#>       25% 
#> -0.746055 

## Set package-wide default (e.g. in .Rprofile)
old <- options(kstools.quantile.type = 7L)
ks_q1(rnorm(100))   # now uses type 7
#>        25% 
#> -0.6657538 
options(old)         # restore
